title: Preserving a matrix on an interval
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $A$ be an $n$-by-$k$ matrix of integers, and let $\mu,\mu' : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}$. Suppose that $\mu(a+ik+j)=A_{ij}$ for every $i<n$ and $j<k$, and that $\mu'(b)=\mu(b)$ whenever $a\le b<a+nk$. Then $\mu'(a+ik+j)=A_{ij}$ for every $i<n$ and $j<k$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is an integer matrix indexed by $i<n$ and $j<k$
$\mu'$ agrees with $\mu$ on the interval $a\le b<a+nk$
